title: Export Scope
summary: Reads back exactly what an export file will hold, so it doesn't go out as page 1 of 250, silently capped or full of personal data.
description: Reads back exactly what the file holds (rows and page, filters, the date range as real dates with a day count, hidden and personal-data columns) with toggles and a one-tap "Export all" or "Mask it" fix.
catches: Exporting only the current page when all rows were meant
Exports silently capped at a row limit
Active filters and the real date range, with a day count
Hidden columns and personal-data columns, with a mask option
limits: Reads back the scope you describe; it doesn't produce the file
Which columns hold personal data is up to your scope definition
a11y: Options are role="radiogroup" segmented controls with roving tabIndex and arrow keys
The readback is written in text
server: Apply the same scope, row limit and masking when generating the file on the server, and log exports of personal data.
